description: Provision an AWS Opensearchserverless Collection via the ACK opensearchserverless controller. Fields mirror the opensearchserverless.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1 Collection spec.

name.description:
Name of the collection.

Regex Pattern: `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]+$`

region.description: AWS region for this resource (e.g. eu-west-1). Rendered as the services.k8s.aws/region annotation. Empty inherits the ACK controller's default region.
region.title: AWS region

standbyReplicas.description: Indicates whether standby replicas should be used for a collection.

tags.description:
An arbitrary set of tags (key–value pairs) to associate with the OpenSearch
Serverless collection.

items.description: A map of key-value pairs associated to an OpenSearch Serverless resource.

title: AWS Opensearchserverless Collection
